d:
What if one AI assistant could bring a dairy farmer’s world together?
Breeding. Health. Nutrition. Milk quality. Payments.
For years, these have existed as separate services. Sarlaben, an AI assistant for dairy farmers,
brings them together — connecting Amul’s dairy knowledge with information about farmers
and their cattle to give personalized advice, all in a language they understand and can act on.
Built for 3.6 million Amul dairy farmers across 18,000+ villages, Sarlaben is helping make dairy knowledge more accessible, one conversation at a time.
